## Eigene Beispiele / Code

::: panel-tabset
## R

```r
t.test(x, y, paired = FALSE)
aov_model <- aov(y ~ group, data = df)
summary(aov_model)
```

## Python

```python
from scipy import stats
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x, y)
print(t_stat, p_val)
```
